concerns.text: FR-003 requires metrics 'for every code-comment pair in the dataset' and US-2 says metrics are calculated 'for each comment variant against the source code and the human baseline'. The plan computes BLEU/ROUGE-L/SBERT only for LLM comments (null for human/none rows). Either the plan should state explicitly that only LLM-condition pairs are scored per the correlation design (and why this satisfies FR-003), or the spec's FR-003 scope should be narrowed. Currently the implementer has no task covering human/none-variant metric computation that FR-003 literally demands.
